role: diagnostic reuse of previously scored heldout; no training or new acceptance claim

combined.solver: global interval branch-and-bound, independent-term and Taylor lower bounds

training_strength_caveat: Original training optimizes q in [.5,1.5] then deployment uses G=1+.425*(q-1). Primary combined oracles evaluate the training functional at physical G. Fixed-prediction report also solves original q optimum and applies strength afterward.
eligibility: Same history/confidence/fade/nonzero gates as installed model; no future information changes eligibility directly.
rho: From baseline predictions; zero-energy denominators excluded and counted, all-nonzero and relative-band-energy>1e-6 distributions reported separately. Quartiles describe evaluation-frame occurrences, not independent speakers.
safety: same binary hash across both CPU shards
bit-exact diagnostic versus ordinary native baseline/current in every replay
complete unique matrix; matching immutable shard protocols
all six variants freshly scored in same build; archive drift reported separately
interpretation: Noncausal future-target oracles do not establish learnability by a causal MLP.
Per-frame fixed-prediction MDCT optimum is not a global waveform optimum through OLA and state feedback.
Only MDCT oracle minimizes MDCT error; combined optimum is not an SNR upper bound.
Rho alone does not demonstrate audible quality or the cause of a training plateau.
revision_reason: Initial attempts to reuse archived quality metrics stopped on tiny archived baseline/current error differences. Final study freshly scores all six variants in one binary; historical equality is not a cross-build bitwise contract. All native hook and input invariants remain exact.
